51 uint16_t len)
52{
53 int32_t ret;
54
55 if (ctx == NULL)
56 {

59

61
62 return ret;
63}

183int32_t asm330lhhx_xl_full_scale_set(const stmdev_ctx_t *ctx,
184 asm330lhhx_fs_xl_t val)
185{
186 asm330lhhx_ctrl1_xl_t ctrl1_xl;
187 int32_t ret;
188
189 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_CTRL1_XL, (uint8_t *)&ctrl1_xl, 1);
190 if (ret == 0)
191 {
192 ctrl1_xl.fs_xl = (uint8_t)val;
193 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_CTRL1_XL,
194 (uint8_t *)&ctrl1_xl, 1);
195 }
196 return ret;
197}

223 *val = ASM330LHHX_4g;

226 *val = ASM330LHHX_8g;
227 break;
228 default:
229 *val = ASM330LHHX_2g;
230 break;
231 }
232 return ret;
233}

296 {
297 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_26Hz;
298
299 }
300 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_12Hz5)

303
304 }
305 else
306 {
307 odr_xl = val;
308 }
309 break;
310 case ASM330LHHX_ODR_FSM_52Hz:

312 if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_OFF)

336 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
337
338 }
339 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_12Hz5)
340 {
341 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
342
343 }
344 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_26Hz)
345 {
346 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
347
348 }
349 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_52Hz)
350 {
351 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
352
353 }
354 else
355 {
356 odr_xl = val;

358 break;
359 default:
360 odr_xl = val;
361 break;
362 }
363 }
364 }
365 }
366
367 /* Check the Machine Learning Core data rate constraints */
368 mlc_enable = PROPERTY_DISABLE;
369 if (ret == 0)
370 {
371 ret = asm330lhhx_mlc_get(ctx, &mlc_enable);
372 if (mlc_enable == PROPERTY_ENABLE)
373 {
374
375 ret = asm330lhhx_mlc_data_rate_get(ctx, &mlc_odr);
376 if (ret == 0)
377 {
378 switch (mlc_odr)
379 {
380 case ASM330LHHX_ODR_PRGS_12Hz5:
381
382 if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_OFF)
383 {
384 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_12Hz5;
385
386 }
387 else
388 {
389 odr_xl = val;
390 }
391 break;
392 case ASM330LHHX_ODR_PRGS_26Hz:
393 if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_OFF)
394 {
395 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_26Hz;
396
397 }
398 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_12Hz5)
399 {
400 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_26Hz;
401
402 }
403 else
404 {
405 odr_xl = val;
406 }
407 break;
408 case ASM330LHHX_ODR_PRGS_52Hz:
409
410 if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_OFF)
411 {
412 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_52Hz;
413
414 }
415 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_12Hz5)
416 {
417 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_52Hz;
418
419 }
420 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_26Hz)
421 {
422 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_52Hz;
423
424 }
425 else
426 {
427 odr_xl = val;
428 }
429 break;
430 case ASM330LHHX_ODR_PRGS_104Hz:
431 if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_OFF)
432 {
433 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
434
435 }
436 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_12Hz5)
437 {
438 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
439
440 }
441 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_26Hz)
442 {
443 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
444
445 }
446 else if (val == ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_52Hz)
447 {
448 odr_xl = ASM330LHHX_XL_ODR_104Hz;
449
450 }
451 else
452 {
453 odr_xl = val;
454 }
455 break;
456 default:
457 odr_xl = val;
458 break;
459 }
460 }
461 }
462 }
463
464 if (ret == 0)
465 {
466 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_CTRL1_XL, (uint8_t *)&ctrl1_xl, 1);
467 }
468 if (ret == 0)
469 {
470 ctrl1_xl.odr_xl = (uint8_t)odr_xl;
471 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_CTRL1_XL,
472 (uint8_t *)&ctrl1_xl, 1);

474 return ret;

823 }
824 break;
825 default:
826 odr_gy = val;
827 break;
828 }
829 }
830 }
831 }

834 {
835 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_CTRL2_G, (uint8_t *)&ctrl2_g, 1);

838 {

840 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_CTRL2_G, (uint8_t *)&ctrl2_g, 1);
841 }
842 return ret;
843}

1769int32_t asm330lhhx_ln_pg_write_byte(const stmdev_ctx_t *ctx, uint16_t add,
1770 uint8_t *val)
1771{
1772 asm330lhhx_page_rw_t page_rw;
1773 asm330lhhx_page_sel_t page_sel;
1774 asm330lhhx_page_address_t page_address;
1775 int32_t ret;
1776
1777 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_EMBEDDED_FUNC_BANK);
1778 if (ret == 0)
1779 {
1780 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1781 }
1782 if (ret == 0)
1783 {
1784 page_rw.page_rw = 0x02U; /* page_write enable */
1785 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1786 }
1787 if (ret == 0)
1788 {
1789 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL, (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1790 }
1791 if (ret == 0)
1792 {
1793 page_sel.page_sel = (uint8_t)((add / 256U) & 0x0FU);
1794 page_sel.not_used_01 = 1;
1795 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL,
1796 (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1797 }
1798 if (ret == 0)
1799 {
1800 page_address.page_addr = (uint8_t)(add - (page_sel.page_sel * 256U));
1801 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_ADDRESS,
1802 (uint8_t *)&page_address, 1);
1803 }
1804 if (ret == 0)
1805 {
1806 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_VALUE, val, 1);
1807 }
1808 if (ret == 0)
1809 {
1810 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1811 }
1812 if (ret == 0)
1813 {
1814 page_rw.page_rw = 0x00; /* page_write disable */
1815 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1816 }
1817 if (ret == 0)
1818 {
1819 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_USER_BANK);
1820 }
1821 return ret;
1822}
1823
1834int32_t asm330lhhx_ln_pg_write(const stmdev_ctx_t *ctx, uint16_t add,
1835 uint8_t *buf, uint8_t len)
1836{
1837 asm330lhhx_page_rw_t page_rw;
1838 asm330lhhx_page_sel_t page_sel;
1839 asm330lhhx_page_address_t page_address;
1840 int32_t ret;
1841 uint8_t msb, lsb;
1842 uint8_t i ;
1843
1844 msb = (uint8_t)(add / 256U);
1845 lsb = (uint8_t)(add - (msb * 256U));
1846
1847 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_EMBEDDED_FUNC_BANK);
1848 if (ret == 0)
1849 {
1850 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1851 }
1852 if (ret == 0)
1853 {
1854 page_rw.page_rw = 0x02U; /* page_write enable*/
1855 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1856 }
1857 if (ret == 0)
1858 {
1859 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL, (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1860 }
1861 if (ret == 0)
1862 {
1863 page_sel.page_sel = msb;
1864 page_sel.not_used_01 = 1;
1865 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL,
1866 (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1867 }
1868 if (ret == 0)
1869 {
1870 page_address.page_addr = lsb;
1871 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_ADDRESS,
1872 (uint8_t *)&page_address, 1);
1873 }
1874 for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
1875 {
1876 if (ret == 0)
1877 {
1878 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_VALUE, &buf[i], 1);
1879 if (ret == 0)
1880 {
1881 /* Check if page wrap */
1882 if (lsb == 0x00U)
1883 {
1884 msb++;
1885 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL,
1886 (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1887 }
1888 lsb++;
1889 }
1890 if (ret == 0)
1891 {
1892 page_sel.page_sel = msb;
1893 page_sel.not_used_01 = 1;
1894 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL,
1895 (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1896 }
1897 }
1898 }
1899
1900 if (ret == 0)
1901 {
1902 page_sel.page_sel = 0;
1903 page_sel.not_used_01 = 1;
1904 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_SEL,
1905 (uint8_t *)&page_sel, 1);
1906 }
1907 if (ret == 0)
1908 {
1909 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1910 }
1911 if (ret == 0)
1912 {
1913 page_rw.page_rw = 0x00U; /* page_write disable */
1914 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_PAGE_RW, (uint8_t *)&page_rw, 1);
1915 }
1916 if (ret == 0)
1917 {
1918 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_USER_BANK);
1919 }
1920 return ret;
1921}
1922
1932int32_t asm330lhhx_ln_pg_read_byte(const stmdev_ctx_t *ctx, uint16_t add,
1933 uint8_t *val)

1979 }
1980 if (ret == 0)
1981 {
1982 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_USER_BANK);
1983 }
1984 return ret;

3731 asm330lhhx_lir_t *val)
3732{
3733 asm330lhhx_int_cfg0_t int_cfg0;
3734 asm330lhhx_page_rw_t page_rw;
3735 int32_t ret;
3736
3737 *val = ASM330LHHX_ALL_INT_PULSED;
3738 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_INT_CFG0, (uint8_t *)&int_cfg0, 1);
3739
3740 if (ret == 0)
3741 {
3742 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_EMBEDDED_FUNC_BANK);
3743 }

3745 {

3747 }
3748 if (ret == 0)
3749 {
3750 ret = asm330lhhx_mem_bank_set(ctx, ASM330LHHX_USER_BANK);
3751 }
3752 switch ((page_rw.emb_func_lir << 1) + int_cfg0.lir)
3753 {
3754 case ASM330LHHX_ALL_INT_PULSED:
3755 *val = ASM330LHHX_ALL_INT_PULSED;
3756 break;
3757 case ASM330LHHX_BASE_LATCHED_EMB_PULSED:
3758 *val = ASM330LHHX_BASE_LATCHED_EMB_PULSED;
3759 break;
3760 case ASM330LHHX_BASE_PULSED_EMB_LATCHED:
3761 *val = ASM330LHHX_BASE_PULSED_EMB_LATCHED;
3762 break;
3763 case ASM330LHHX_ALL_INT_LATCHED:
3764 *val = ASM330LHHX_ALL_INT_LATCHED;
3765 break;
3766 default:
3767 *val = ASM330LHHX_ALL_INT_PULSED;
3768 break;
3769 }
3770 return ret;
3771}

4487int32_t asm330lhhx_fifo_watermark_set(const stmdev_ctx_t *ctx, uint16_t val)
4488{
4489 asm330lhhx_fifo_ctrl1_t fifo_ctrl1;
4490 asm330lhhx_fifo_ctrl2_t fifo_ctrl2;
4491 int32_t ret;
4492
4493 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_FIFO_CTRL1, (uint8_t *)&fifo_ctrl1, 1);
4494 ret += asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_FIFO_CTRL2, (uint8_t *)&fifo_ctrl2, 1);
4495
4496 if (ret == 0)
4497 {
4498 fifo_ctrl1.wtm = (uint8_t)(val & 0xFFU);
4499 fifo_ctrl2.wtm = (uint8_t)((val / 256U) & 0x01U);
4500 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_FIFO_CTRL1, (uint8_t *)&fifo_ctrl1, 1);
4501 ret += asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_FIFO_CTRL2, (uint8_t *)&fifo_ctrl2, 1);
4502 }
4503
4504 return ret;
4505}

4516{

4518 asm330lhhx_fifo_ctrl2_t fifo_ctrl2;
4519 int32_t ret;
4520
4521 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_FIFO_CTRL2,
4522 (uint8_t *)&fifo_ctrl2, 1);
4523 if (ret == 0)
4524 {
4525 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_FIFO_CTRL1,
4526 (uint8_t *)&fifo_ctrl1, 1);

4528 *val = fifo_ctrl2.wtm;
4529 *val = (*val * 256U) + fifo_ctrl1.wtm;

5122int32_t asm330lhhx_batch_counter_threshold_set(const stmdev_ctx_t *ctx, uint16_t val)
5123{

5128 ret = asm330lhhx_read_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_COUNTER_BDR_REG1,
5129 (uint8_t *)&counter_bdr_reg1, 1);
5130 if (ret == 0)
5131 {
5132 counter_bdr_reg1.cnt_bdr_th = (uint8_t)((val / 256U) & 0x07U);

5134 (uint8_t *)&counter_bdr_reg1, 1);
5135 }

5137 {
5138 counter_bdr_reg2.cnt_bdr_th = (uint8_t)(val - (counter_bdr_reg1.cnt_bdr_th * 256U));
5139 ret = asm330lhhx_write_reg(ctx, ASM330LHHX_COUNTER_BDR_REG2,
5140 (uint8_t *)&counter_bdr_reg2, 1);
5141 }
5142 return ret;

6229 }
6230 if (ret == 0)

6235 if (ret == 0)

6239 }

6241 {
6242 i++;
6243 ret = asm330lhhx_ln_pg_read_byte(ctx, ASM330LHHX_MAG_SI_ZZ_H, &buff[i]);
6244 }
6245
6246 val[0] = buff[1];
6247 val[0] = (val[0] * 256U) + buff[0];
6248 val[1] = buff[3];
6249 val[1] = (val[1] * 256U) + buff[2];
